statement_summary: One group program aligned to CSF 2.0 meeting each division's binding rules
Group CISO accountable; Home Health designates HIPAA officials; Consulting HIPAA compliance officer
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level; no acceptance of High patient-safety or unpaid-worker risks
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Divisions document inherited common controls and confirm yearly
Sanctions documented by HR and privacy officials
No contract, no data; BAA must cover the specific service; marketplace add-ons are vendors
Privacy impact assessment before any new feed or feature moving personal information or PHI
Annual assessment of common controls and division samples
Retention of security documentation 6 years; legal record periods per schedule
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard

statement_summary: Unique identities, including in E-Verify, client, and agency systems
Role-based least privilege for I-9 images, consumer reports, medical files, patient data
MFA for all workforce; phishing-resistant for administrators
Out-of-band confirmation and 3-day hold for bank changes; no SMS-only after 2027-03-31
Service accounts owned, governed, rotated; one identity per client integration
Termination within 4 hours; E-Verify on the checklist; per diem accounts expire
Register and timely removal of client-issued accounts
Quarterly access certification including E-Verify and service accounts
Just-in-time privileged access with recording
Federal Solutions enclave access limited to assigned consultants with MFA
One group severity scale and playbooks
Discovery and determination dates recorded per law
Immediate E-Verify breach notice to DHS
Home Health breach decisions; Consulting and corporate business associate notices
Counsel-owned multi-regulator matrix reviewed quarterly
Escalation to the disclosure committee within 24 hours; Item 1.05 within 4 business days of materiality
Repeat-payroll decision and associate communications in a pay incident
Annual cross-division exercise with the matrix and a materiality decision
Classification with Restricted class for SSNs, I-9, consumer reports, medical files, PHI, FCI
Encryption and tokenization of Restricted information
Data map for every store of Restricted information
Purpose and minimum necessary between divisions; visit records identify visits, not patients
Use limits for I-9, E-Verify, medical files, client PHI, FCI
